title: Install Spec Kit for Windsurf Cascade and Claude Code
description:
Install and configure Spec Kit (github/spec-kit) on this machine so it can be used consistently from both Windsurf Cascade and Claude Code environments.

Requirements:
- Spec Kit installed and up to date
- Verify it can be invoked from workflows used by Windsurf Cascade
- Verify it can be invoked from workflows used by Claude Code
- Document basic usage and any environment/setup steps needed (PATH, permissions, etc.)

Acceptance Criteria:
- A simple test Spec Kit command or workflow runs successfully from both tools' contexts
- Any necessary configuration steps are captured in project docs or a short note in the appropriate place.
